topic: Why adults need 7–9 hours of sleep
hook: Do you stay awake late scrolling reels and wonder why you feel exhausted all day?
caption:
Rathri poota nidra manesi reels chusthunnara? Idi mee arogyam meda chala pedda prabhavam chupthundi! Manam roju ki 7 nundi 9 gantala nidra povadam entha avasaramo ee reel lo chudandi. Share this with your friends who stay up late!

#SleepHealth #HealthyHabits #TeluguHealth #SleepCycle #WellnessTelugu #HealthyLifestyle #DeepSleep #SelfCare
poster_caption:
Most people think sleep is just downtime. It's actually when your body performs its most critical maintenance. 💤

Here is what happens when you hit that 7-9 hour sweet spot:
• Flushes out toxic brain plaque via the glymphatic system
• Balances hunger hormones to stop late-night cravings
• Boosts immune defenses and cellular repair

📌 Save this guide for your daily health routine!

#SleepScience #Biohacking #RecoveryProtocol #HealthyHabits #SleepBetter #Longevity #WellnessTips #Arovia360
